أنبثق (form VII)
# أَنْبَثِقُ (ʔanbaṯiqu) /ʔan.ba.θi.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْبَثَقَ (inbaṯaqa)
# أَنْبَثِقَ (ʔanbaṯiqa) /ʔan.ba.θi.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْبَثَقَ (inbaṯaqa)
# أَنْبَثِقْ (ʔanbaṯiq) /ʔan.ba.θiq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْبَثَقَ (inbaṯaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
